products.accountingBoundary: One complete BP8 pack including cells, protection, balancing, telemetry electronics and heater. EPS/P80, harness, mating connectors and spacecraft structure are external. Pack electronics and heater mass are not additional installed products.

supportedConfigurations: Type A only: PIU mainboard + top-mounted PBP-2S1P battery. DaughterBoard is not compatible with this Type A arrangement.
Three mainboard MPPT channels and 3.3 V, 5 V and raw-battery domains. Custom cell or rail options need a separately characterized record.
products.accountingBoundary: One complete Type A PIU + PBP-2S1P assembly. Battery cells, board, heater and integrated MCUs are inside the 184 g typical assembly mass. Count the product once across battery/conditioning/distribution/processor roles. The envelope explicitly excludes CSKB, while the mass table gives no CSKB breakout. EGSE, harness and separately sold stack frames are external.
caveats: Capacity is internally inconsistent. Page 2 advertises 28.2–57.6 Wh and a 7.2 V / 28.8 Wh two-cell option. Table 2 gives default cells 3.2 Ah, which implies 23.04 nominal Wh for 2S at 3.6 V/cell. No energyWh value is adopted.
The charge/discharge current row has Min/Typ/Max values without an explicit safe pack-current envelope. The full tuple is retained, while generic maximum charge/discharge fields remain unresolved.
MPPT functional range is 3.5–7.5 V for Type A. The separate 15 V absolute maximum is not the tracking limit. Above the functional range, power can pass without boost tracking per footnote 12.
Storage recoverability ≥80% is a storage-condition statement, not an orbital cycle-life or EOL retention factor.
MCUs and FRAM are explicitly documented. Firmware version, available processor/memory resources and scheduling evidence are missing. No software role is claimed.
